slides.texte_overlay:
the sunday reset that makes
my whole school week easier

i look at the whole week first.
tests, deadlines, anything big. no surprises on wednesday.

one list with every homework and its day.
not in my head. on paper.

15 minutes testing myself on last week's lessons.
whatever i forgot goes on monday's list.

bag packed for monday.
books, pens, charger, water bottle.

desk cleared.
monday-me sits down and starts. no tidying first.

no scrolling in bed on sunday night.
i start the week rested, not wired.
